draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 39th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 34 at DE. He went 28th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Preston Smith. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 sacks in 2020, 16th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions (reserve). 31 career games and 0 starts over 4 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2024 against a career-best 1 in 2021. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 16.0% (9th percentile), approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 edge rusher who played: 2.0 sacks against a median of 3.0, below the norm.
